strings: m_c comes in to see r_c0, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} tail twitching as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} consult with {PRONOUN/r_c0/object} on how to make decision making easier.
m_c stands beside the camp entryway somewhat frozen, talking with the deputy about what patrol to potentially go on.
m_c sits, tail tip twitching as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} try to decide what prey to eat.
m_c paces back and forth, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can't decide if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} should ask the deputy whether {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can go to the gathering.
